page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, providing a one-to-one core-to-thread ratio. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor. This configuration does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage must be network-attached. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data shows strong multi-core performance, with the instance scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing also fall into the top tier of performance. Conversely, single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core, rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, along with Redis SET operations, also perform within the average range.

For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, static web serving throughput, and small-model LLM inference for both prompt processing and text generation. However, medium-model LLM inference speeds drop to average levels, and large-model inference is unsupported due to memory and hardware constraints. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated resource allocation and high multi-core density make it appropriate for enterprise-grade multi-threaded applications, database hosting, and web serving, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires external storage provisioning.
